The PIN can\'t be recovered, because it encrypts your Crafty login. CraftyCtrl will sign out, turn off server alerts and forget the panel address and login on this phone. Your servers on Crafty aren\'t touched.

Ask for an app PIN (and optionally your fingerprint) when opening CraftyCtrl. While locked, your Crafty login stays encrypted with the PIN.
Picking a file, opening a link or the battery settings from CraftyCtrl doesn\'t count as leaving, unless you stay away for more than 5 minutes.
CraftyCtrl has no analytics or tracking. It only talks to your own Crafty panel, plus Mojang\'s player lookup and Crafty\'s server version list when you use those.

Server alerts are on, so they keep their own copy of your Crafty login, encrypted with the Android Keystore, to keep working while CraftyCtrl is locked. Turn off server alerts to keep it sealed with your PIN only.
